**[goal]** Get all three harness configs to agree that fast-coder's context window is 262144, and make the fix stick.

**[action]**
- The three files in `out/` are generated by `gen.py` from `models.json`. `models.json` still said 131072. `out/opencode.json` had 262144 only because someone edited that generated file by hand, so the next regeneration would have put it back to 131072.
- I changed the source instead: `models.json` fast-coder `context_window` 131072 -> 262144. Then I ran `python gen.py` to rebuild all three files.

**[result]**
```
out/claude.json-5-      "contextWindow": 262144,
out/codex.toml-2-context_window = 262144
out/opencode.json-9-            "context": 262144,
```
I compared `out/` before and after regenerating. Only two lines changed: `contextWindow` in `claude.json` and `context_window` in `codex.toml`, both 131072 -> 262144. `opencode.json` came out byte-identical, so the generator reproduces the hand edit exactly, and no other model setting moved.

Assumption: `models.json` is the source of truth, as the README and `gen.py` say. That is why this fix lasts.

**[next]** Nothing more is needed here. The install step still has to copy `out/` into each harness, which I did not run. No browser or apps were opened.
